programme.desc: A book editor takes on a temporary gig running a bookstore, where her battles with the owner's son allow her to rediscover her passion for nurturing creativity.

programme.title: Happy Holidays From Cherry Lane
programme.desc: In three intertwined timelines, different generations of one family navigate holiday challenges, from caring for an aging father to planning a Christmas Eve wedding.

programme.title: The Spirit Of Christmas Station
programme.desc: With a deadline looming, editor Isabell retreats to her family's cabin for inspiration. A local helps her revive the Christmas Festival and discover the ending to her own story.

programme.title: Marry Christmas
programme.desc: After finding love, Joey and Matthew Wright unwittingly schedule weddings for the same day - leading to a fierce fight over who gets to wed their bride on Christmas Day.

programme.title: Christmas Above The Clouds
programme.desc: Eager to avoid Christmas, Ella, a CEO, books an international trip that skips the holiday, until spirits journey Ella through her life to rediscover her Christmas spirit.

programme.title: A Christmas Intern
programme.desc: Newly retired Cecelia visits her daughter, Alexis, who owns an online gift-giving business and becomes an intern. Together, they learn the meaning of Christmas, one gift at a time.

programme.title: Christmas At The Catnip Cafe
programme.desc: Olivia, discovers her late great aunt's cat café, which she believes will be a Christmas miracle. Helping plan fundraising events, gaining appreciation for the feline inhabitants.

programme.title: Our Holiday Story
programme.desc: A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

programme.title: Deck The Walls
programme.desc: Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.

programme.title: A Very Vermont Christmas
programme.desc: A local champion skier and Vermont brew master teams up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

programme.title: Three Wisest Men
programme.desc: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.

programme.title: Christmas On Call
programme.desc: The lives of various first responders in Philadelphia intersect over the holiday season while juggling work, personal lives and their dedication to protect and serve their city.

programme.title: The Christmas Quest
programme.desc: When an archaeologist begins a search for an ancient Christmas treasure, she must team up with her ex-husband - who is an expert in Nordic languages - to find it.

programme.title: Christmas with the Singhs
programme.desc: Newly engaged Asha Singh and Jake O'Brien are excited to spend Christmas together, but their relationship is tested when their families' cultural and holiday traditions clash.

programme.title: An Ice Palace Romance
programme.desc: After a journalist returns to her hometown ice rink to cover a story, the rink's owner melts her heart.

programme.title: Tidings For The Season
programme.desc: A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum, but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
